current_official_controls_note: The current directly governing state or local election-office source controls for this case. National routing pages, generalized official explainers, and archive summaries are routing aids only and are not substitutes for the current official instruction that directly governs the voter's jurisdiction and election scope.
deadline_imminence_note: Do not assume an older FAQ, PDF, screenshot, or cached directory still controls today's path. If the cutoff is near or may already have passed, confirm the current live deadline with the responsible office and pivot immediately to the stated fallback or confirmation path if the original route is no longer operable.
freshness_note: Re-verify whenever provisional-ballot issuance reasons, wrong-place rules, unsurrendered-mail-ballot fallback, partial-count semantics, or ID follow-up rules change for the election. v857 metadata refresh keeps this synthetic template inside its declared review window; current direct official sources still control and this template is not voter instruction.
minimum_necessary_disclosure_note: Send only the personal information the current official process requires. Do not post or send full Social Security numbers, driver's license numbers, dates of birth, confidential residence details, court papers, custody records, or other sensitive identifiers through public, unverified, or generalized channels.
official_secure_channel_note: Use only the named official website, secure HTTPS form, verified office phone, or in-person office path for sensitive case details and documents. If the current public instructions do not show a secure submission path, call the responsible election office first before sending records.
operability_now_note: Before relying on this path under same-day or near-cutoff pressure, verify that the responsible office, portal, site, or delivery route is still open and operating right now using the latest official hours/closure notice, current update page, or verified office phone.

additional_voter_steps: Review the official poll-site finder before deciding whether to remain on the provisional path.
Complete the provisional application or envelope fully if you choose to cast here.
reasons.alternate_regular_ballot_option: Go to the assigned precinct for a regular ballot if time and travel permit.
reasons.count_scope_note: If state law allows it, only contests the voter is eligible to vote for based on home address may count.
reasons.followup_deadline_note: Check the provisional-ballot status surface after the canvass window opens.
reasons.label: Incorrect precinct
reasons.plain_language: You appeared at a polling place that is not the precinct assigned to your residential address for Election Day voting.

additional_voter_steps: Bring or send acceptable identification to the named office by the posted deadline if state law requires follow-up.
reasons.count_scope_note: The ballot will count only if the voter completes the required ID follow-up by the jurisdiction's deadline.
reasons.followup_deadline_note: ID follow-up must occur by the deadline stated on the official instructions.
reasons.label: Missing or unverified ID
reasons.plain_language: You were unable to present or verify the identification required for this voting path at the time of check-in.

additional_voter_steps: Show the unsurrendered ballot if you have it.
Follow the printed instructions on whether a provisional ballot or another fallback path applies.
reasons.alternate_regular_ballot_option: If the jurisdiction allows surrender of the original mail ballot at the site, follow that path for a regular ballot instead of assuming provisional voting is required.
reasons.count_scope_note: The provisional ballot will be reviewed to make sure no other ballot from the voter was already counted.
reasons.followup_deadline_note: Use the official provisional-ballot status tool to confirm whether the ballot counted.
reasons.label: Outstanding mail ballot
reasons.plain_language: Your record indicates that a mail ballot was issued and could not be surrendered or verified as unused at check-in.

superseding_notice_note: Older pages, PDFs, screenshots, packet inserts, or archived summaries may remain visible. Follow the most current official notice, form, correction, update, or replacement instruction and use the dated or last-updated cue when available.
unresolved_conflict_stop_note: If current official materials still materially conflict, disagree, or leave a controlling gap, do not synthesize an answer from fragments. Treat that unresolved conflict as a stop condition and use the responsible official office or help path for case-specific confirmation; move to the rights/safety escalation lane when the conflict is paired with likely wrongful denial, intimidation, discrimination, or unsafe exposure.
